metadata.desc: Controls framework default LLM replies based on an allowlist. Users in the allowlist trigger LLM normally, others are silently skipped or receive a custom reply. Also supports a timed 'open window' for the whole group.

enable_groups.hint: One line per platform, format: platform[group1,group2,...]. Only groups in the list activate this plugin; other groups are untouched (LLM replies normally). Empty = all groups.

admin_bypass.hint: When enabled, admins bypass the allowlist and always trigger the framework default LLM reply. Covers AstrBot global admins (all platforms) and group owner/admins (aiocqhttp only).

allowlist.hint: One line per platform, format: platform[UID1,UID2,...]. Users in the allowlist trigger the framework default LLM reply normally, others are silently skipped.

reply_msg.hint: One line per platform, format: platform[reply]. Non-allowlisted users receive the platform-specific reply. Replies attempt quote reply first, then @ reply, then plain text.

vent_enabled.hint: When enabled, admins can send '放风5分钟' in a group: for that long, everyone in the group bypasses the allowlist. It closes automatically on expiry, '收风' closes it early and '放风状态' shows the remaining time.

vent_allowlist_can_vent.description: Allowlisted Users Can Open A Window
vent_allowlist_can_vent.hint: Off by default: only admins (AstrBot global admins and group owner/admins) may open or close a window. When on, allowlisted regular users may too.

vent_default_minutes.hint: Duration used when the command carries no duration.

vent_max_minutes.hint: Longer durations are capped to this value. 0 = no cap.

vent_expire_notify.hint: When enabled, the group gets a 'window closed' notice when the timer runs out; when disabled the window closes silently (direct replies to the command are unaffected).
